title: How to Let an AI Agent Access a User’s Account Safely
body: Why an AI agent changes the security picture. A normal login authenticates a person who is present and reacting to what they see.Time-limit it and make it revocable. Let the user set how long access lasts and revoke a single agent’s connection at any time, without affecting others.
